subject: Re: Next steps & POC plan — model selection for trial
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@shopflow.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & proposed POC success criteria (ShopFlow)

Hi Elena,

Great speaking with you and the ShopFlow team today — thanks for walking through the primary use cases. Quick recap and proposed POC plan so we’re aligned: 

Summary of ask
- Ingest internal help center + product FAQ and enable a multilingual customer-support assistant (EN / ES) for first-line responses and suggested KB articles.
- Latency target for responses: median < 500ms for single-turn queries; 95th < 1.2s (for hosted trial).
- Quality: > 85% relevance in our spot-check evals on your 200-sample set.

Proposed POC (2 weeks) — success criteria
1) Functional: assistant returns appropriate article links or short answer for 85%+ of evaluation prompts across EN/ES test sets.
2) Performance: median latency < 500ms over representative traffic (50 RPS burst testing with Redwood hosted dev pool).
3) Safety/PII: no leaking of internal PII in responses; passes our initial safety filters.
4) Integration: webhook + simple UI demo operating against your staging dataset.

Model plan (recommendation)
- Primary model: Mistral-7B-v0 (open) — good balance of accuracy and latency for retrieval-augmented generation.
- Quantized runtime: 4-bit optimized on Redwood — reduces cost and should meet latency SLO for the trial.
- Fallback: Llama2-13B (quantized) — if edge cases show factuality issues or we need broader context memory.
- Multilingual: for Spanish prompts, route to the same primary model but enable Spanish tokenizer and evaluate quality; if we see degradation, fall back to a dedicated multilingual variant (e.g., Mistral-multi or Llama2-13B).

Owners & timeline
- Redwood owner: Ben Carter (sales) — primary contact for logistics and deal items.
- Technical owner: Marissa Cole — will run the model selection, deploy trial config, and own evaluation harness.
- Customer owner: Elena (ShopFlow) — provide 200-sample eval set (EN/ES), staging data access, and test users.

Next steps
1) Elena to share eval set + staging access by Tue 17 Feb.
2) Redwood to push initial POC config and shortlist models by Wed 18 Feb.
3) Quick alignment call Wed 18 Feb 11am PT (30m) to finalize runbook.

I attached a short POC template and a draft of success criteria for your legal/procurement team. Let me know if anything major is missing.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: ShopFlow_POC_success_criteria.docx, POC_plan_template.xlsx
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@shopflow.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, ShopFlow Procurement <procure@shopflow.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap & proposed POC success criteria (ShopFlow)

Thanks Ben — this looks good and closer to what we discussed. A couple quick things: 

- We can provide the 200-sample eval set (150 EN, 50 ES) by EOD Tue 17 Feb.
- Staging S3 access: I’ll send credentials to Marissa in a separate secure email.
- A couple of notes from support: Spanish coverage is critical for a subset of users (we need parity for top 30 intents). If Mistral-7B shows gaps we’ll want a fallback.

Procurement note:
- We’ll need a short MSA addendum for the trial (IP/data handling + retention 30 days). Looping in procurement.

Confirming the Wed 11am PT call — Elena + engineering lead Alex will be on.

— Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Product | ShopFlow
elena@shopflow.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@shopflow.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap & proposed POC success criteria (ShopFlow)

Nice to meet you on the call earlier. Quick technical notes and plan after our alignment: 

Technical runbook (initial) - Deploy retrieval-augmented setup (FAISS index on staging docs) + generator model.
- Candidate models for the trial: Mistral-7B-v0 (primary), Llama2-13B (fallback), Mistral-multilingual-v1 (if Spanish quality < target).
- Quantization: run 4-bit int8 equivalent on dedicated dev pool to hit latency targets.
- Batching: small dynamic batching (up to 4) to keep median latency low while managing throughput.

Evaluation plan - Redwood will run the 200-sample eval across the three candidate models and produce: relevance %, hallucination flags, latency distribution (median / p95), and token-cost estimates.
- Ownership: Marissa will produce the eval report and share a short scoreboard by Fri 20 Feb EOD.

Logistics - I’ll need S3 read access + a sample of labeled intents if available.
- We’ll provision a short-lived API key and generate test traffic (will not ingest production IDs).

Attachments: POC_plan_template.xlsx (with proposed timeline).

Planned deliverables by Fri 20 Feb:
1) Model eval scoreboard (EN + ES).
2) Recommended primary + fallback with config and estimated costs.
3) Runbook for integration and suggested rollout steps.

If that timeline works, Ben — can you confirm procurement has what they need for the MSA addendum?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior ML Platform Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@shopflow.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap & proposed POC success criteria (ShopFlow)

Thanks everyone — quick procurement and timeline confirmation from Redwood side.

Procurement / Legal
- We can do a 30-day retention addendum for trial data. I’ve attached the short template the procurement team uses for trials (no-cost POC).
- Elena / ShopFlow: if procurement needs a contact, please share an email and I’ll connect.

Timeline confirmation - Marissa to deliver the eval scoreboard by EOD today (Fri 20 Feb).
- Redwood will start the trial run Mon 23 Feb once S3 creds and eval set are received.

Ben — I’ll follow up with a short DocuSign link for the addendum if ShopFlow confirms.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_trial_addendum_template.docx
